units.title: Introduction to Pharmaceutical Chemistry
units.topics: Introduction and Scope of various field of pharmaceutical science including pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmaceutics, pharmacognosy, pharmacology. Important aspects of pharmaceutical chemistry, brief history of pharmacy, pharmacopeia names, meaning & contents, monograph in I.P. Drug and Dosage form: Definition, ideal condition of drugs, Classification of drug, Sources of drug, Routes of drug administration. Types of dosage forms: Solid, Semisolid, Liquid, Parenteral, Novel drug delivery system.

units.title: Prescription, Pharmaceutical Aids, Diseases and Herbal Medicines.
units.topics: Prescription: Definition, parts of prescription, reading, handling, modern methods of prescribing. Pharmaceutical aids: Preservatives, colorants, flavoring agents, sweetening agents. Common diseases: Communicable and non-communicable diseases, symptoms and prevention. Herbal medicines: Overview of indigenous systems (Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy), common medicinal plants.

units.title: Impurities in Pharmaceutical Substances
units.topics: Source of impurities, effect of impurities in pharmaceutical substances. Limit test: Principle, reaction and procedure of limit test for Chloride, Sulphate, Iron, Heavy metals and Arsenic.

units.title: Study of Inorganic Pharmaceutical Compounds
units.topics: Gastrointestinal agents: Antacids, Acidifying agents, Protectives and Adsorbents, Cathartics. Topical agents: Protectives, Antimicrobials, Astringents. Dental products: Dentifrices, Desensitizing agents, Anticaries agents. Respiratory stimulants, Expectorants, Emetics.

units.title: Energy forms, Units and Conversion:
units.topics: Energy: Definition, Different forms of energy - Potential, Kinetic, Mechanical, Heat, Electrical, Chemical, Magnetic, Gravitational Energy, work, power and energy. Various units of energy: Calorie, joule, erg, BTU, kWh, Horse Power. Energy conversion processes, efficiency of conversion, first and second laws of thermodynamics in energy conversion.

units.title: Energy Sources – Conventional:
units.topics: Fossil fuels: Coal, Oil, Natural gas - reserves, exploration, production and environmental impacts. Thermal power plants, Hydroelectric power generation, Nuclear power: fission, fusion, nuclear reactors, nuclear waste management.

units.title: Photo thermal applications of solar energy:
units.topics: Solar radiation, measurement, flat plate collectors, concentrating collectors, solar water heating systems, solar distillation, solar drying, solar cookers.

units.title: Photovoltaic applications of solar energy:
units.topics: Solar cell principles, semiconductor materials, PV cell characteristics, PV modules and arrays, balance of systems (BOS), grid-tied and stand-alone PV systems, applications of PV.

units.title: Introduction and Principles of Horticulture
units.topics: Definition, Scope of Horticulture, Importance of Horticulture in Human Life.

units.title: Branches of Horticulture
units.topics: Pomology, Olericulture, Floriculture, Landscape gardening, Plantation crops, Spices and Condiments, Medicinal and Aromatic plants.

units.title: Modern Trends in Horticulture
units.topics: Protected cultivation, Greenhouse, Polyhouse, Hydroponics, Aeroponics, Vertical farming, Precision horticulture.

units.title: Site Selection, Soil, Climate management:
units.topics: Factors influencing site selection, Soil types, soil fertility, soil management, Climatic factors: temperature, humidity, rainfall, light and their management.

units.title: Plant propagation Techniques:
units.topics: Natural: Creepers, Runner, Sucker, Tuber, Rhizome, Bulbs, Corms. Artificial vegetative propagation: Cutting, Layering, Grafting, Budding, Micropropagation / Tissue culture.

units.title: Horticultural Practices
units.topics: Planting systems, pruning, training, irrigation methods (drip, sprinkler), nutrition management (organic and chemical fertilizers), weed management.

units.title: Post-Harvest Management
units.topics: Harvesting maturity indices, handling, grading, packing, storage, cold chain, preservation techniques, value addition in fruits and vegetables.

units.title: Government policies / Schemes for promoting fruit crops
units.topics: National Horticulture Mission (NHM), National Horticulture Board (NHB), subsidies, export promotion, APEDA role.

units.title: Introduction
units.topics: Definition, Branches of entomology: Agricultural, Medical, Forest, Forensic and Industrial entomology. Economic importance of insect with reference to product, pollination, scavengers and weed killers.

units.title: Agricultural Pests
units.topics: Major insect pests of agricultural crops: sugarcane, cotton, paddy, vegetables and fruits. Life cycle, damage and management of common crop pests.

units.title: Medical and Veterinary Entomology
units.topics: Insect vectors of human diseases: mosquitoes (malaria, dengue), housefly, sandfly, fleas, lice. Veterinary pests and their impact on livestock.

units.title: Beneficial Insects
units.topics: Apiculture (Honey bee biology, products, management), Sericulture (Silkworm rearing, silk production), Lac culture (Lac insect biology and cultivation).

units.title: Pest Management Strategies
units.topics: Integrated Pest Management (IPM): Cultural, physical, mechanical, chemical, and biological control methods. Biopesticides and pheromone traps.

units.title: Introduction to Animal Husbandry
units.topics: Importance of livestock in Indian economy, Trends in milk production, Dairy development programs.

units.title: Housing of Dairy Animals
units.topics: Selection of site, types of dairy barns (loose housing vs conventional), sanitation and drainage in cattle sheds.

units.title: Feeds and Feeding of Dairy Animals
units.topics: Classification of feeds and fodders, roughages, concentrates, feeding standards for dairy cattle and buffaloes.

units.title: Cultivation of Fodder Crops
units.topics: Important cereal and legume fodder crops (Maize, Sorghum, Berseem, Lucerne), silage and hay making.

units.title: Ration Balancing
units.topics: Principles of ration formulation, thumb rules of feeding, balanced ration for calves, heifers, lactating and dry cows.

units.title: Cattle Breeds
units.topics: Indigenous dairy breeds (Gir, Sahiwal, Red Sindhi), dual-purpose breeds (Kankrej, Tharparkar, Ongole), exotic breeds (Holstein Friesian, Jersey).

units.title: Buffalo Breeds
units.topics: Important Indian buffalo breeds: Murrah, Jaffarabadi, Surti, Mehsana, Nagpuri, Pandharpuri.

units.title: Routine Management Practices
units.topics: Identification, dehorning, castration, grooming, milking methods (clean milk production), vaccination schedule.

units.title: Introduction to Soap Industry
units.topics: History and evolution of soap making, raw materials used in soap manufacture: fats, oils, alkalis, builders, fillers, perfumes, colors.

units.title: Chemistry of Saponification
units.topics: Saponification reaction, saponification value, iodine value, acid value, titer of fatty acids, selection of oils and fat blends for different soaps.

units.title: Manufacturing Processes of Soaps
units.topics: Cold process, semi-boiled process, full-boiled process, continuous saponification, finishing operations: drying, plodding, cutting, stamping, packaging.

units.title: Types of Soaps and Quality Standards
units.topics: Toilet soaps, laundry soaps, medicated soaps, transparent soaps, shaving soaps. BIS specifications and quality control tests for soaps.

units.title: Fundamentals of Radio and Electronic Components
units.topics: Active and passive components: identification, specification and measurement. Resistors, capacitors, inductors, transformers, diodes, transistors.

units.title: Measuring Instruments and Power Supplies
units.topics: Multimeters (Analog and Digital), CRO, Signal Generator, Regulated power supply circuits: rectifiers, filters, voltage regulators.

units.title: Radio Transmission and Reception Principles
units.topics: Modulation concepts (AM and FM), superheterodyne receiver principle: RF amplifier, mixer, local oscillator, IF amplifier, detector, AGC, audio amplifier.

units.title: Troubleshooting and Servicing Techniques
units.topics: Common faults in radio receivers, signal tracing and signal injection methods, component replacement techniques, safety precautions during servicing.

units.title: Introduction to Nursery Development
units.topics: Definition, Importance and scope, Types of Nurseries: Fruit plant nursery, Vegetable nursery, Ornamental plant nursery, Forest nursery.

units.title: Nursery Infrastructure and Media
units.topics: Site selection, nursery layout, mother beds, potting shed, mist chamber, shade net house, soil and potting media preparation, sterilization.

units.title: Plant Propagation in Nursery
units.topics: Seed propagation, seed viability, seed dormancy and germination treatments, vegetative propagation methods, handling of saplings.

units.title: Nursery Management and Marketing
units.topics: Water management, nutrition, disease and pest management in nursery, packaging, labeling, transport, business planning and marketing of nursery plants.

units.title: Introduction to Clinical Laboratory and Safety
units.topics: Role of clinical laboratory in disease diagnosis, laboratory organization, glassware, sterilization techniques, bio-safety and biomedical waste management.

units.title: Hematology Basics and Specimen Collection
units.topics: Composition and functions of blood, collection of blood samples (phlebotomy), anticoagulants, blood film preparation and staining techniques (Leishman, Giemsa).

units.title: Routine Hematological Investigations
units.topics: Estimation of hemoglobin, total RBC count, total WBC count, differential leukocyte count (DLC), platelet count, ESR and PCV determination.

units.title: Clinical Pathology of Urine and Stool
units.topics: Routine examination of urine: physical, chemical, and microscopic examination. Routine examination of stool: physical, chemical, and microscopic examination for parasites.

units.title: Introduction to Milk
units.topics: Definition of milk, gross composition of milk of different species, factors affecting composition of milk, physical and chemical properties of milk.

units.title: Sanitation in Clean and Safe Milk Production
units.topics: Sources of contamination of milk, clean milk production practices, sanitation of dairy farm equipment and milking parlors.

units.title: Dairy Microbiology
units.topics: Microorganisms associated with milk, milk-borne diseases, preservation of milk by chilling, pasteurization methods (LTLT, HTST, UHT).

units.title: Introduction to Dairy Chemistry
units.topics: Constituents of milk: milk fat, proteins (casein, whey proteins), lactose, minerals, vitamins, enzymes, legal standards of milk.

units.title: Introduction to Dairy Products
units.topics: Classification of dairy products, market milk types (standardized, toned, double toned, skimmed, homogenized milk).

units.title: Concentrated and Dehydrated Milk Products
units.topics: Principles of concentration and drying, condensed milk, evaporated milk, milk powder (SMP, WMP) manufacturing basics.

units.title: Fermented Milk Products
units.topics: Starter cultures, manufacturing process and nutritional significance of Dahi, Lassi, Yogurt, Shrikhand, and Chhach.

notes: S.Y.B.Sc. Restructuring Pattern syllabus covering Vocational Skill Courses (VSC) and Co-curricular Courses (CC) for Semester III and IV.
